name: dsdv_sh_lk-dsdv_sh_lk-COMMIT
purpose: S81-DV seq_host leaf dsdv_sh_lk to closure (TT setup / FF hold / DRC 0 + native audit).

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; dsdv_sh_lk u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/lib/ot_rst_relay.sv rtl/lib/ot_async_fifo.sv rtl/lib/ot_reset_sync.sv rtl/link/ot_link_afifo.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ctrl/ot_s81_secded.sv rtl/hdc/ingest/ot_hdc_ingest_fp8q.sv rtl/hdc/ingest/ot_hdc_kv_ingest.sv rtl/hdc/ingest/ot_rom_host_ingest.sv physical/rom_host_ingest/rtl/dsfd_host.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ingest/ot_s81_ingest_visibility_fence.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ingest/dsfd_host_native.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ingest/dsfd_host_sd.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_dv/unit/dsdv_seq_host.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/dsdv_sh_lk/signoff_ffrepair.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/dsdv_sh_lk/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/dsdv_sh_lk --out {RUN}/record/views/dsdv_sh_lk  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: S81U-SEQ (S81-DV p4f..p4i, owner-approved DV plan): L0 link leaf of dsdv_seq_host: host lane port + host ingest (dsfd_host_native, unchanged) + host write decode (dsfd_host_sd STATIC) + svc / kit ports + regional status fold + one rung hop each way; flop-first / flop-last pins, die hold budget.
